en.headline: Asia Outdoor Pet Fest opens today at Kai Tak Sports Park East Village
en.dek: The three-day event, title-sponsored by ZA Bank, features pet markets, outdoor activities and a cat zone on more than 80,000 square feet of lawn from today to Sunday.
body: Asia Outdoor Pet Fest opens today at the East Village of Kai Tak Sports Park and runs until Sunday, organised by Can Move Production House and title-sponsored by ZA Bank.

The organisers said the event is built around the theme of people and pets together and occupies more than 80,000 square feet of outdoor lawn. It includes a marketplace with more than 70 pet and lifestyle brands, outdoor sports activities for people and pets, a dedicated cat zone, food and coffee stalls, and workshops.

Opening hours are 12:30 pm to 8:30 pm today, and 10:30 am to 8:30 pm on Saturday and Sunday. Standard admission is HK$100 for one person, with higher rates for tickets that include a pet; children under 10 enter free with a ticket holder. VIP tickets offer priority access.
The venue is reachable by a short walk from Sung Wong Toi MTR station. The organisers noted that the festival aims to provide outdoor space for pet owners and their animals in the city.

zh.headline: 亞洲戶外寵物節今日於啟德體育園東營開幕
zh.dek: 由ZA Bank冠名贊助的三日活動，今日起至周日在逾八萬平方呎草坪舉行，設寵物市集、戶外活動及貓咪專區。
body: 亞洲戶外寵物節今日於啟德體育園東營開幕，一連三日至周日結束，由Can Move Production House主辦、ZA Bank冠名贊助。
主辦方表示，活動以人寵共融為主題，佔地逾八萬平方呎戶外草坪，設有逾七十個寵物及生活品牌的市集、人寵戶外運動、貓咪專區、美食咖啡檔及工作坊。
今日開放時間為中午十二時三十分至晚上八時三十分，周六及周日為上午十時三十分至晚上八時三十分。普通門票單人一百元，連寵物票價較高；十歲以下小童隨持票人士免費入場。VIP門票設優先通道。
場地從宋皇臺港鐵站步行約八至十分鐘可達。主辦方指，活動旨在為寵主及毛孩提供市區戶外空間。
